description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Austria working-day offset. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when nationwide statutory holiday list only. Werktag is not uniform across Austrian legal domains; Saturday treatment, provincial patron days, school, bank, employer and sector schedules are not inferred.
What it computes: Adds or subtracts Austria authority-scope working days in exact coverage.
Example user requests: Add or subtract Austria working days around Austrian National Day. | Add or subtract Austria working days around Ordinary weekday.
Inputs: start_date (date); working_days (integer).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2026-01-01","working_days":0}
Outputs: start_date, result_date, working_days_added, calendar_days_elapsed, public_holidays_skipped, territory, territory_name, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: move one day at a time; decrement only on status.is_working_day=true
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/austria-public-add-working-days with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/austria-public-add-working-days.md

working_days.description: Signed offset; start date excluded for non-zero offsets.

name: add_at_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Austria nationwide statutory public holidays for 2026-2027

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

holiday_policy.description: Austria's nationwide statutory public holidays are included; provincial patron-saint days, school holidays and employer/sector closures are not inferred.

substitute_day_policy.description: No substitute-day closure is inferred for a holiday falling on Sunday; Austrian holiday-rest and Sunday-rest rules remain distinct from an invented next-working-day closure.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Add Austria Working Days
